title: Omnigent — a meta-harness for building and running AI agents
excerpt: Omnigent is an open-source meta-harness: a common layer for composing, governing, and collaborating on AI agents — coding and otherwise — on top of the harnesses you already use.
content_html:
A common layer over Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and the agents you write yourself: swap or combine harnesses without rewriting, keep them in check with policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time on the same live session, from any device.

$ curl -fsSL https://omnigent.ai/install.sh | sh

Get Started macOS App iOS App Android App Join Discord

Features

  • Polly & Debby: built-in multi-AI agents (a coding orchestrator and a model debate). Build your own in YAML.
  • Contextual Policies: stateful spend caps, model routing, and risk-based escalation.
  • Secure Sandboxes: run any agent in a local OS sandbox or a remote cloud sandbox. On Linux and macOS, restrict filesystem and network access and broker credentials without exposing them to the agent.

What Omnigent gives you

Composition

Combine multiple models, harnesses, and techniques without rewriting code. Switch between Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and your own agents with one-line changes.

Architecture

A runner wraps any agent in a uniform session that can run in a local OS sandbox or a remote cloud sandbox. A server adds policies and shared history, and exposes every session over the terminal, the web, a native app, mobile, and a REST API.

Omnigent is open source and built in the open. Try it and give us feedback on Discord.

Join the Discord Events
